text: Standing outside the glass-walled meeting room, I sense a quiet separation between those engaged in communal dialogue and myself as a curious observer. The second scene, with its vivid colors and bold 'R+D' sign, makes me feel drawn into a celebration of innovation and collective inquiry. Overall, I am both an outsider—witnessing collaboration from afar—and a participant—immersed in the energetic spirit of research and discovery. This duality provokes reflection on the boundaries between inquiry and participation, solitude and community.
